title: CVE-2026-120311 - Network-AI from 5.13.4 before 5.15.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in FileJobStore that al
description: Network-AI from 5.13.4 before 5.15.5 contains a path traversal vulnerability in FileJobStore that allows attackers to read or delete arbitrary .json files by supplying traversal sequences in the job id. Attackers controlling the id passed to FileJobStore.get(), FileJobStore.delete(), or JobQueue.getJob() can disclose credentials and grant tokens or delete configuration files to weaken AuthGuardian authorization.

title: CVE-2026-120310 - Parse Server before 8.6.109 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.6-alpha.1 returns stored field values in object up
description: Parse Server before 8.6.109 and 9.0.0 before 9.10.6-alpha.1 returns stored field values in object update responses without checking read access, so clients whose class-level permissions or object ACLs allow update but not read can see object data. Attackers can update such objects to read atomic operation results (Increment, Add, AddUnique, Remove), Cloud Code trigger-set values, and, for dot notation keys under certain conditions, the whole stored parent field.

title: CVE-2026-120309 - Nuxt from 4.6.0 before 4.6.2 contains a route parameter confusion vulnerability in getRouterParam an
description: Nuxt from 4.6.0 before 4.6.2 contains a route parameter confusion vulnerability in getRouterParam and getRouterParams that lets attackers return a parameter value different from the one h3 matched by sending paths containing an encoded question mark (%3F). Attackers can craft requests where authorization checks use the Nuxt helper value while resource selection uses event.context.params, allowing access to unauthorized resources.
